narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>A decimal divisor always gives a bigger answer.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Two point five is a decimal, but it is bigger than one.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Let us test it before we believe it.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Compare the divisor with one, not with a counting number.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>More than one gives smaller, one gives the same, and less than one gives bigger.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. Is seven point five divided by zero point five bigger or smaller than seven point five?
